categories.title: Eyebot Upgrade
categories.info: Collected to upgrade the Camarader-E perk and unlock the ED-Ecated achievement/trophy.

categories.title: Holotape
categories.info: Holotapes are audio recordings found through the wasteland. They provide lore and details about the world.

categories.title: Skill Book
categories.info: Skill Books permanently raise the corresponding skill by 3 points. The Comprehension perk raises this increase to 4 points.

categories.title: Skill Magazine
categories.info: Skill Magazines are consumable items that raise a skill by 10 points for 60 seconds. The Comprehension perk raises the skill increase to 20, while the Retention perk increases the duration to 3 minutes.

categories.title: Snow Globe
categories.info: Gathered as part of the unmarked quest [Useless Baubles or Fancy Trinkets?](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=510014) where each snow globe is worth 2000 caps.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Armor raises your Damage Threshold, resulting in less damage from attacks. It degrades with use, and must be repaired with similar items (or anything from the same category with the Jury Rigging perk).
